280870782.description:
Natural Specimen Collection
Geode and Mineral Rock Lot
Amethyst, Pyrite, and Quartz
Varying Dimensions
Natural and Enhanced Specimens
This diverse collection of six geological specimens features a range of natural and treated minerals. The set includes a notable amethyst cluster with embedded pyrite cubes mounted on a glass base, originally sourced from Park City, Utah. Also included is a translucent amethyst crystal point with a "Made in Brazil" provenance, and a vibrant red titanium-coated aura quartz specimen featuring a high-luster iridescent finish.
Includes large milky quartz and yellow quartz rough specimens measuring approximately 3.5 inches
Features natural amethyst druzy with cubic pyrite inclusions from a known Utah locality
Set contains a mix of raw mineral points, clusters, and a smooth polished accent stone
Condition:
Very good overall condition. Natural specimens exhibit expected geological textures and raw edges. The aura quartz coating is uniform and bright. The mounted Utah specimen is securely attached to its glass display base. Total lot weight is 1.0 lb.

Add a touch of natural elegance to your space with this striking cut geode. Featuring a polished face that reveals stunning crystal formations and unique banding, this piece dazzles with a blend of gray, white, and earthy tones. The irregular geometric slice contrasts beautifully with its rugged back and edges, making it an eye-catching decorative object for shelves, desks, or bookcases. Crafted from genuine geode, the stone's polished surface highlights captivating natural patterns while the rough back delivers rustic charm. Its sturdy flat bottom allows for easy upright display, letting light play across the crystalline interior for a beautiful effect. Perfect for collectors, enthusiasts, or anyone looking to bring natural artistry into their decor. This geode shows minor edge roughness yet remains clean and visually impressive. Display as a standalone piece or pair with other minerals for a curated look
